description: This file defines a class for table manipulation in a rich text editor, including functions for adding/removing rows and columns, deleting tables, and managing virtual table states for complex table operations.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A class providing methods to manipulate HTML tables, such as adding/removing rows and columns, deleting tables, and handling tab navigation within table cells.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Handles tab key navigation within table cells, moving focus to next or previous cell.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row either at the top or bottom of the current table.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a new column either to the left or right of the current cell.

methods.name: recoverAttributes
methods.description: Copies attributes from a DOM element, excluding 'id'.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Deletes the row containing the specified cell, adjusting rowspan as needed.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Deletes the column containing the specified cell, adjusting colspan as needed.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates an empty table element with specified rows and columns.

methods.name: deleteTable
methods.description: Removes the entire table containing the specified cell.
